smoke.description: Foundation installs and loads on a real server

core-log.description: Logger lines reach the server console intact
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: progress 100% done %s %d note=\*\*\* password=\*\*\*$
\[foundation\] WARN  foundation-core-log-test/repeat: previous message repeated 2 more times$

core-audit.description: Audit records are appended to daily files through the real File API
allowed_errors: \[foundation\] ERROR foundation/core: audit record could not be written to foundation/blocked\.txt/
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] ERROR foundation/core: audit record could not be written to foundation/blocked\.txt/audit-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\.log; record kept in this log line reason=.*Cannot create a file.* record=.*foundation:fallback_marker

core-packages.description: Package registration follows the real Load/Unload events across reload and unload
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: foundation-packages-fixture disabled: package unloaded

core-runtime.description: Foundation boots, exports its read-only global and disables packages at server stop
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: foundation-core-runtime-test disabled: Foundation is stopping
\[foundation\] ERROR foundation/core: validator callback of foundation-core-runtime-test failed validator=foundation-core-runtime-test:broken

core-runtime-reload.description: Reloading Foundation alone is reported with a recovery command
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] WARN  foundation/core: Foundation was unloaded while 1 package\(s\) still use it \(foundation-core-runtime-reload-test\).*Run 'package reload foundation-core-runtime-reload-test' or restart the server

core-lifecycle.description: Reloading a dependent or a dependency through the real Foundation global
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: foundation-lifecycle-beta disabled: a dependency was disabled

core-shutdown.description: At server stop, packages are disabled newest first, dependents before dependencies

docs-examples.description: Examples shown in the public documentation run as documented
expected_log_sequence: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: foundation-example-greeter disabled: Foundation is stopping
expected_log_lines: rejected: invalid value \(2 problem\(s\)\): \$\.items\[2\]: expected string, got integer
rejected: 'Bad Kit' is not a valid key:
daily reward: 250 \(Here is your daily reward!\)

core-json.description: Foundation JSON interoperates with the engine JSON library

core-i18n.description: Package catalogs, plurals, fallback and missing keys through the real Foundation global

core-config.description: foundation/config.toml is created, read with the engine TOML parser, validated and applied
expected_log_sequence: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/config: created foundation/config\.toml with the default settings
\[foundation\] ERROR foundation/config: foundation/config\.toml is invalid \(3 problem\(s\)\)
foundation/config\.toml: \$\.log\.level: must be one of debug, info, warning, error
foundation/config\.toml: \$\.log\.extra: is not an allowed field
\[foundation\] ERROR foundation/config: foundation/config\.toml is not used
\[foundation\] ERROR foundation/config: could not read foundation/config\.toml: .*TOML\.Parse

core-package-config.description: Package configuration files through the real Foundation global and engine TOML parser
expected_log_sequence: \[foundation\] ERROR foundation-config-fixture/config: foundation/config/foundation-config-fixture\.toml: \$\.motd: must have at most 32 characters

core-scheduler.description: Scheduler tasks on real engine timers, with cleanup when the owner unloads
allowed_errors: \[foundation\] ERROR foundation/core: task callback of foundation-core-scheduler-test failed
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] WARN  foundation-core-scheduler-test/scheduler: repeating task of foundation-core-scheduler-test stopped after 2 consecutive failures

core-future.description: Futures over native async database queries and real timers
allowed_errors: Failed to execute Select query: 'SELECT \* FROM missing_table'
